description.en: Shuvuuia deserti: whole living environment prop. Nominal whole length 0.6m ART SETTING. Oxford 2021 museum prose and photographed Mick Ellison AMNH skull and partial skeleton, accession not provided. Very short stout single dominant claw arms, long runner hindlimbs, delicate elongate skull. Tail dimensions and flesh, muted sandy graybrown color and short filament cover are artistic inference. No owl facial disc, crest, wings, fossil copying or whole single-specimen claim.
